mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, created_at, updated_at, version_no FROM articles ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO articles (title, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = #{versionNo} + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version_no = #{versionNo}
